title: Where Time Stood Still
build: Ocean's original 128K release (TOSEC: Where Time Stood Still (1988)(Ocean)(128K)[aka Land That Time Forgot, The][aka Tibet].tzx), a BASIC loader and SpeedLock 4 turbo blocks: the loading screen, 22,183 bytes of program, five 16 KB banks and 9,472 bytes of bank 7

records.c: The second screen's pixels, $C000-$C3FF (bank 7 is the screen the 128K can show instead of bank 5): the view is drawn into whichever screen is not shown and the two are swapped (main $9987). Zeros at the hand-over.

For each area 0 to 15 the address of its scenery record, read by $8850 with bank 7 paged in: areas 0 and 1 share one, area 8's lies in main RAM at $6859, and the words for areas 12 and 15 ($0005, $3501) point into the ROM: no route, record or object is in either.

Area 0 and 1's scenery record ($8A9B): 1 box of eight bytes for bank 4's list at $C000 (shape, first and last column, first and last row, and where it stands), 1 record of four bytes for bank 3's list at $C000, then the area's map of 64 by 32 blocks packed into bank 0 $C000-$C7FF: an $FF is followed by a count and the byte to repeat, any other byte is one block.
Areas 0 and 1's map, packed: 64 by 32 blocks for bank 0's $C000-$C7FF.
